verdict.rationale: Flagsmith explicitly supports overriding feature flags for individual users via 'identities', documented for internal testing, QA, and personalized experiences, plus segment-based targeting for group-based allowlists (e.g., beta testers). This is a well-documented core feature directly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent third-party hands-on confirmation of identity-level overrides specifically (probes verify flag creation/eval but not the identity-override workflow itself).
